question: In a certain code language. FOUR' is written as '6PV18'. How will 'DARK' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'FOUR' is written as '6PV18',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9708bc3222986866d2b507664cf3c19cc42aa76ba0f0ad09a92d42b478409e79.png] 

Similarly, for '**DARK**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bc52af4e4fb9c00fa047bed9bc3d453d414a2cf2b87c364b3ef418e84b61711.png] 

So, 'DARK' will be written as '**4BS11**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
